definitionZh: 持续时间超过 swipe.duration（以毫秒为单位）的拖动手势永远不会被视为滑动。有关更多信息，请参阅 [swipe](/docs/state/#swipe) 状态属性。
sourceDefinition: A drag gesture lasting more than swipe.duration (in milliseconds) will never be considered a swipe. See the [swipe](/docs/state/#swipe) state attribute for more.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: A drag gesture lasting more than swipe.duration (in milliseconds) will never be considered a swipe. See the [swipe](/docs/state/#swipe) state attribute for more.
